summary: SoundHound AI, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of LivePerson, Inc. via two-step merger on September 4, 2026, under an Amended and Restated Merger Agreement dated July 2, 2026. Merger Subs I and II merged with and into LivePerson, making it an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. The filing also notes entry into a registration rights agreement with holders of LivePerson's secured convertible notes. Terms such as price per share or implied value are not stated. The acquisition closed immediately; no regulatory hurdles remain. Watch for post-closing integration and any note conversion overhang.
